title: 增长目标4.7%：结构改革要等2027，债市先计入什么？
speaker: Carlos Casanova

segments.en: my growth target for 2026 is 4.7 percent so I think it's going to get us past that sort of 4.5 percent
segments.zh: 我对2026年的增长目标是4.7%，所以我认为这将使我们超过4.5%左右。

segments.en: anything structural will require us to wait until after 2027 and the reason for that is we have a huge political meeting in the calendar
segments.zh: 任何结构性举措都需要等到2027年之后，原因是日程上有一个重要的政治会议。

segments.en: that's the 21st Communist Party Congress that is expected to take place in the fall that pays the way for President Xi to start his fourth term
segments.zh: 那就是预计在秋季召开的第二十一届党代会，为相关领导层开启第四个任期铺路。

segments.en: there's leadership changes and no one's going to stick their neck out in their last year to restructure the property market
segments.zh: 领导层会有变动，没有人会在最后一年冒险去重组地产市场。

segments.en: but essentially what's happening is some of these big companies have a lot of exposure in areas where there are no job opportunities
segments.zh: 但本质上，一些大型企业在没有就业机会的地区有大量敞口。

segments.en: so it's not so much or entirely about the rental yield there's also no one wants to move to these areas because there are no jobs
segments.zh: 所以这并不完全是租金回报的问题，也没有人愿意搬到这些地区，因为没有工作。

segments.en: and so if you look if you have an installed stock invent inventories of homes in third year cities that just needs to get restructured somehow
segments.zh: 所以如果你看三四线城市的住房库存，这些库存需要以某种方式重组。

segments.en: and that's not going to happen until after 2027
segments.zh: 而这要到2027年之后才会发生。

segments.en: And you know the bond market has increasingly started to price in just you know a more challenging macro
segments.zh: 你知道，债券市场已越来越开始计入更具挑战性的宏观环境。

segments.en: I think the CGP yields and 10 is 166 we're closing in on 2 percent on the 30 year yield
segments.zh: 我认为10年期国债收益率是1.66%，30年期收益率正接近2%。

segments.en: are bond markets too bearish on the economy yes and no the other thing with the China stimulus
segments.zh: 债券市场对经济是否过于悲观？既是也不是。中国刺激的另一点是。
